contracts.blurb: Two hundred Instagram shops hand you every parcel they sell.
Your warehouse feeds their shelves every Monday, scanned and counted.
Maize and sesame come south on your trailers, so no truck returns empty.
A factory moves bagged cement to Abuja on a weekly contract.
Cars and textiles cross the Seme border through your bonded depot.
Cocoa and sesame leave Apapa in your booked containers.

belt.name: Parcel Conveyor Belt
belt.blurb: Carries parcels from the drop-off yard to the sorting table by itself.

auto.name: Yard Forklift Team
auto.blurb: Automatic forklifts move containers from the paperwork desk to the loading bays.

pack.name: Quay Gantry Crane
pack.blurb: Lifts containers off the ship and stacks them in the yard with no carrying.

milestones.title: First Hub Opens
milestones.blurb: A second Wakaway hub. Parcels now cross Lagos without passing Yaba.

milestones.title: Lagos Covered
milestones.blurb: Five hubs. Any seller in Lagos is ten minutes from a Wakaway counter.

milestones.title: Every Big City
milestones.blurb: Abuja, Kano, Port Harcourt and Onitsha hubs. Waybills arrive next day.

milestones.title: West Africa Corridor
milestones.blurb: Cotonou, Lome and Accra hubs. The coast road is your road.

milestones.title: National Shippers' Council Seat
milestones.blurb: Ifeanyi now speaks for Nigerian cargo owners.

milestones.title: Four Continents
milestones.blurb: Durban, Dubai, Rotterdam and Guangzhou desks book your containers.

milestones.title: Rider Training School
milestones.blurb: Wakaway trains riders: helmets on, safe first, fast second.

milestones.title: MV Waybill, Pride of Tin Can
milestones.blurb: Wakaway Lines owns ships with Ifeanyi's nickname on the hull.

Oga, two boxes are at day four. Clear them first.
Kano has a return load. Send the next trailer.

Tomorrow I must service those trucks.

Maybe one more hub in Abuja?
Two boxes still have free days. Good.
Uncle Chidi's okada started all of this.

events.name: Detty December Rush
events.text: Everybody is sending gifts. Parcel orders double for today.

events.name: Third Mainland Go-Slow
events.text: Heavy traffic on the bridge. Bike deliveries take twice as long today.

events.name: Diesel Price Jump
events.text: Diesel is up again. Every haulage trip costs 10% more today.

events.name: Return Load Found
events.text: A Kano trader has grains for Lagos. Your trucks earn on the way back today.

events.name: Rainy Day Parcels
events.text: Heavy rain. Customers are waiting it out, so fewer parcels today.

events.name: Five-Star Review
events.text: A big online seller praises Wakaway. New customers arrive all day.

events.name: Port System Down
events.text: The customs portal is offline. The paperwork desk clears fewer boxes today.

events.name: Naira Gains Today
events.text: The exchange rate moved your way. Ocean freight earns 5% more today.

mech.name: Shoulder and head carry
mech.how: Lifts parcels from the drop-off yard on head and shoulder and walks them to the sorting table

mech.name: Hand trolley
mech.how: Two-wheel trolley tips back under a stack of cartons and rolls to the scale

mech.name: Cargo tricycle
mech.how: Keke cargo loads sacks and cartons at the yard and drops them at the counter

mech.name: Delivery van
mech.how: Van backs into the yard, side door slides, cartons go in and come out at the dispatch counter

mech.name: Diesel forklift
mech.how: Forks slide under a pallet or a 20ft box, lift and carry it to the loading bay

mech.name: Reach stacker
mech.how: Big arm grabs a 40ft container by its corners and sets it on the trailer

storyNote: Story stages follow plan2/shipping.json. The clearing-licence stage no longer contains any shortcut offer: bribery does not exist in this game.
